claim: G31 P3 R1: the builder can carry a native-constructed source-bearing revision request and model observation losslessly through durable JSON while exposing only compact parse-safe native stdout, without spending or changing the original one-call grant during preflight.
non_claims: No additional model call, larger model envelope, changed repair request, candidate qualification by serialization, live Mattermost contact, Mattermost credential, message read/send, transport, promotion, activation, universal exactly-once, or control change.
rationale: Attempt 301's PeTTa process succeeded and printed a valid full question, but the builder parser split its multiline string across records. The exact question and provider observation already have durable JSON representations, so compact stdout summaries remove the accidental parser coupling without moving source interpretation or authority out of native cognition.
reading: Retain both controls and the complete ledger. Reread P3 plan, attempt-301 input/native stdout/process/failure, existing native parser behavior, the OpenRouter membrane's durable request/observation artifacts, and C-020-C-024/C-064-C-066/C-095-C-104 with S-501-S-504/S-702/S-903-S-905/S-1001/S-1003-S-1005/S-1101-S-1105.
representation: Add a native compact question standing containing request ID, candidate hash, token/deadline envelope and discrepancy identity without embedding source bytes. After the call, return a compact observation standing while reading exact multiline content from the membrane's JSON observation artifact. Pin both compact and full durable representations and verify their IDs/hashes agree.
consumer: PeTTa/MeTTa still constructs the full request and decides its source-grounded eligibility. Prolog performs the already-bounded OpenRouter mechanics and durable JSON capture. JavaScript reads the durable observation only after native completion and verifies identity before extracting candidate bytes; it neither authors the repair nor changes standing.
falsifiers: Preflight creates a call claim/request; the full question differs from P3 input; compact and durable IDs disagree; source is reconstructed from truncated stdout; a second/larger call is authorized; model content is edited; the exact single-transform acceptance is weakened; or any Mattermost/live/promotion effect occurs.
scope_review: Serialization-only revision to P3 native summaries and builder scripts; preserve attempt 301; rerun a fresh preflight with zero model effects; then use the original single 8192-token/300-second call and the unchanged P3 causal trials if preflight passes. No local Mattermost, Mattermost credential, Docker, message, generic transport, promotion, activation, push, or control change.
rollback: Attempt 301 remains immutable. Reverting the compact summaries and removing R1 artifacts returns the P3 failure with the one-call slot still unspent; no live or promoted state exists.
